final_region_label: resource- and response-sensitive planning balance; no unique deficit classification
permitted_claim: ERCOT's balance changes sign across named resource and response conditions, so results must be reported as a ladder.
prohibited_claim: Do not select one central deficit value or assume all large-load curtailment is data-center response.

final_region_label: buffered across source conditions and the pre-specified partial-additional core diagnostic
permitted_claim: ISO-NE remains at or above its native reference across the tested core source and partial-additional conditions.
prohibited_claim: Do not generalize beyond the tested footprint, load-shape and allocation envelope.

final_region_label: 2035 total-system pressure across source conditions; data-center replacement is load, resource and linked-response sensitive
permitted_claim: MISO is below its native reference by 2035 under all four core source conditions; the DC-specific replacement outcome remains conditional.
prohibited_claim: Do not describe one exact shortage year or a source-independent DC-caused deficit.

final_region_label: positive source balance, but the 2035 sign is sensitive to additional-load magnitude and geography
permitted_claim: NYISO remains above reference on the source path, while additional-load scenarios can reverse the 2035 sign under some allocations.
prohibited_claim: Do not call NYISO either robustly constrained or robustly buffered under all DC allocations.

final_region_label: 2035 total-system pressure across source conditions; the verified data-center floor contributes but does not explain the full gap
permitted_claim: PJM is below its native reference by 2035 under all four core source conditions; removing the verified DC floor does not close the gap.
prohibited_claim: Do not attribute the full planning gap to data centers or treat the strict floor as a complete regional path.

final_region_label: resource-path-sensitive planning pressure; additional data-center load deepens anticipated-path exposure
permitted_claim: SPP pressure appears under anticipated resources and is relieved under the prospective-resource path; added DC load increases the anticipated-path requirement.
prohibited_claim: Do not call SPP unconditionally constrained or report the partial-additional diagnostic as a forecast.

final_region_label: positive source balance; data-center-specific planning attribution is not estimated because the siting and planning footprints do not match
permitted_claim: WECC-California remains above reference across the tested source conditions; DC-specific attribution is left unidentified.
prohibited_claim: Do not insert CAISO siting weights into the broader WECC-California balance.
